CWE-1098.description: The code contains a data element with a pointer that does not have an associated copy or constructor method. In Python codebases this weakness typically appears via high-level APIs (web frameworks, DB-API/ORM, subprocess, pathlib, serialization) rather than raw memory ops.
CWE-1098.detection_notes: Python-oriented (future detector): prefer stdlib/framework sinks (pathlib/os, subprocess, django/flask/fastapi templates & ORMs, pickle/yaml, hashlib/secrets, urllib) over C memory APIs; rewrite detectors per language plugin.
